# CleanTab

> CleanTab is a free, lightweight browser cleaner extension for Chrome, Edge and Opera that clears cache, cookies and history in one click or automatically on a schedule, while keeping you logged in to the sites you choose. The site getcleantab.com also offers free, browser-based privacy tools and plain-English guides about online privacy. Everything in the tools runs locally in the browser, and no user data is collected or stored.

## About

- [Home](https://getcleantab.com/): Overview of the CleanTab extension and its features.
- [About](https://getcleantab.com/about.html): Who builds CleanTab and the philosophy behind it.
- [Guide](https://getcleantab.com/guide.html): How to use CleanTab and get the most out of it.
- [Compare](https://getcleantab.com/compare.html): How CleanTab compares to other cleaning options.

## Free privacy tools

All tools are free, run entirely in the browser, and store no data.

- [What is my IP](https://getcleantab.com/my-ip.html): Shows your public IPv4 and IPv6 address and what it reveals.
- [Password generator](https://getcleantab.com/password-generator.html): Creates strong random passwords.
- [Am I secure](https://getcleantab.com/am-i-secure.html): A quick privacy check-up of your connection and browser.
- [WebRTC leak test](https://getcleantab.com/webrtc-leak-test.html): Checks whether your VPN is leaking your real IP.
- [Password strength test](https://getcleantab.com/password-strength-test.html): Estimates how strong a password is.
- [What is my browser](https://getcleantab.com/my-browser.html): Shows what your browser reveals about you.
- [Encrypt a file](https://getcleantab.com/encrypt-file.html): Password-protects any file locally using AES-256.
- [Remove image metadata](https://getcleantab.com/clean-metadata.html): Strips EXIF and location data from images.
- [Passphrase generator](https://getcleantab.com/passphrase-generator.html): Creates strong, memorable passphrases.
- [Clean a URL](https://getcleantab.com/clean-url.html): Removes tracking parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid and more) from links.

## Install CleanTab

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eghdcennpmcmcdjkdnbggkeikkikdhod): Install the free CleanTab extension on Chrome.
- [Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/maoagfgbdhopoelahkgncponaomjjfki): Install the free CleanTab extension on Edge.
